original_test_intent: Validate CPU0_IN and CPU1_IN as the two approved motherboard CPU inlet sensors, including exact names, descriptions and readings consistently across complete IB SDR, OOB SDR, IB Sensor List, OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The thermal owner maps each inlet probe to CPU socket and physical upstream airflow coordinate, supplies condition-specific limits and expected descriptions, then automation captures complete same-target IB/OOB inventories and Web evidence for engineer comparison.
manual_activity: The thermal/platform owner maps CPU0 and CPU1 to physical inlet probes and approves descriptions, limits and Web entries. No workload, fan/airflow change or log clear is authorized.
required_inputs: Exact inlet-probe coordinate, orientation and airflow relationship per socket
Expected SDR names/entities/descriptions and Sensor List/Web mappings
Units, scaling, accuracy/tolerance, polling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved ranges/states under documented ambient, load and fan condition
Same-target IB host and OOB BMC identity plus firmware/spec revisions
Secret-safe complete IB/OOB collectors and Web evidence method
safety_requirements: Expand only CPU0_IN and CPU1_IN; never query the tilde label as one sensor
Prove IB and OOB address the same system and compare record IDs/names/descriptions/readings
Retain complete SDR and Sensor List before applying CPU filters
Keep inlet probes distinct from CPU junction/package and motherboard outlet temperatures
Do not create load, obstruct airflow, change fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid sensor, unsafe inlet/delta, cross-path mismatch or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, socket/probe topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB and OOB SDR plus Sensor List inventories
Extract two approved inlet records and compare names/descriptions/values/states across paths
Prepare BMC Web parity and passive ambient/fan/CPU context
Perform no thermal stimulus, airflow/fan/threshold control or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve socket-to-inlet-probe mapping and airflow semantics
Provide condition-specific limits and expected descriptions
Confirm Web mapping and IB/OOB parity interpretation
Review both sensors across all five views and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: it omits IB, complete Sensor List and Web evidence, treats the range literally, truncates SDR and exposes credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe same-target IB and OOB sessions to retain complete SDR and Sensor List outputs, extract each approved CPU inlet record without discarding context, then compare the BMC Web entry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CPU0~1_IN, IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List, Web and 3/3-minute estimates remain; probe mapping and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES CPU INLET PROBE MAP, THERMAL CRITERIA AND CROSS-PATH PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a two-row socket/probe matrix and reconcile identity plus values across complete IB/OOB SDR, complete IB/OOB Sensor List and Web evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical inlet provenance, same-target proof and full cross-path parity without changing source scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An OOB exact query alone cannot satisfy the four command views plus Web, and outlet or CPU-die temperature cannot substitute for inlet air.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A mislabeled inlet or IB/OOB record mismatch can hide recirculation or cooling imbalance at one socket.

project_override_considerations: Single-socket builds need an explicit CPU1 N/A rule. If both CPU labels share one physical inlet probe, the owner must document the alias and coverage rather than treating duplicate readings as independent sensors.
expected_evidence: Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Units, freshness and approved condition-specific limits
BMC Web entries and passive ambient/fan/CPU/SEL context
Same-target proof, command statuses and artifact hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criteria consistently require CPU inlet sensors across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and Web. Missing physical mapping and limits are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive two-sensor cross-path check is identifiable; probe mapping and criteria are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Restores all source-required IB/OOB and Web views, adds same-target/record parity and establishes socket-specific physical inlet provenance.
independent_technical_reasoning: An inlet sensor measures the cooling air presented to a socket, not silicon temperature. Probe placement upstream versus within a heatsink wake materially changes acceptable values. Because the source explicitly names both IB and OOB, equal labels are insufficient: record identity and readings must be reconciled on the same target while retaining complete inventories so a filter cannot conceal duplicates.
